On Saturday I went to the market because I needed some apples. I was worried they'd be sold out, but there were lots left, so I was really relieved. Okay, now it's your turn. Child. The beach. We went to the beach. Therapist. The beach. Great choice. Which beach was it? Child. The one with the big rocks. By the café. The beach with the big rocks, by the café. Therapist. What did you do there? Child. I made a sandcastle. A really big one. Therapist. A really big sandcastle. Then what happened? Child. The sea came in, so it got washed away. Therapist. The sea came in, so your sandcastle got washed away. How did that make you feel? Child. Um. I don't know. Therapist. That's okay. Who was at the beach with you? Child. I don't remember. Therapist. That's okay. What happened after that? Child. I went in the water. It was cold. I jumped the waves. Therapist. You jumped the waves. How did that feel? Child. Happy. Therapist. Happy. I bet you were excited too. How did the day end? Child. We had chips in the car. Then we went home. Chips in the car, and then home. Therapist. Let me say your story back to you. You went to the beach with the big rocks, by the café. You made a really big sandcastle, but the sea came in, so it got washed away. You did a really great job.
